# Test fixtures

Real-music tracker modules used only by the test suite (e.g. as sustain-loop
fixtures via `find_mod_fixture_sample`). They are NOT shipped as web demos.
Both are freely licensed (CC-BY) and sourced from The Mod Archive; see the
repository `NOTICE` for attribution.

- `cs127_-_moving_on.it` — cs127, CC-BY, modarchive.org id 205769
- `fuzion_mixer-platonist_-_in_this_world_feat_synx.it` — fuzion_mixer & Platonist, CC-BY, modarchive.org id 210996
